title: Fire
html:
For other possible meanings of Fire in the game, see:  Fire (disambiguation)

⁠Fire is one of the damage types in the game.

  • For all sources of Fire, see Category:Sources of Fire damage.
  • For creatures weak to Fire, see Category:Vulnerable to Fire.
  • For creatures resistant to Fire, see Category:Resistant to Fire.
  • For creatures immune to Fire, see Category:Immune to Fire.

Equipment

The following equipment add Fire damage to the wearer's attacks or can deal Fire damage through other means.

  •  Flawed Helldusk Gloves: Weapon attacks deal +1d4⁠⁠Fire damage.
  •  Gloves of Cinder and Sizzle: Unarmed attacks deal +1d4⁠⁠Fire damage.
  •  Helldusk Gloves: Weapon attacks deal +1d6⁠⁠Fire damage.

Consumables

The following consumable items can be used to deal Fire damage. In the case of arrows, the damage is in addition to the attacker's regular ranged weapon damage.

  •  Arrow of Fire: Deal +2d4⁠⁠Fire in an area.  DEX Save (DC 12) to negate.
  •  Alchemist's Fire: Deal 1d4⁠⁠Fire in an area.

Interactions

  •  Thermoarcanic Gloves: Gain  Heat upon dealing fire damage.
  •  Hat of Fire Acuity: Gain  Arcane Acuity upon dealing fire damage.
  •  Pyroquickness Hat: Dealing fire damage with a non-cantrip spell inflicts  Burning upon the caster but gains them another  Bonus Action.
  •  Grymskull Helm: Gain resistance to fire.
  •  Necklace of Elemental Augmentation: When dealing fire damage with a cantrip, adds the spellcasting modifier to the damage.
  •  Ice surfaces turn into  Water upon receiving fire damage.
  • Torches and similar interactive environment items that can  Burn will light up upon receiving fire damage.
  • Explosive items such as the  Firewine Barrel and  Oil Barrel explode upon receiving fire damage.
  • Flammable surfaces such as  Oil and  Alcohol turn into  Fire upon receiving fire damage.
